snippet.title: Burn With Me demo trailer | Thinky Direct 2026
snippet.description:
Burn With Me is a story-centric deckbuilder filled with cozy dread and occultic mysteries. In order to summon a Personal Demon you'll master inventive gameplay with position-based synergies, and permanently burn your cards and your soul.

Burn With Me by @NozomuGames has an updated demo out!

Burn With Me in the Thinky Games DB:
https://thinkygames.com/games/burn-with-me/
Burn With Me on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2954010/Burn_With_Me/

More info about the Thinky Direct:
https://thinkygames.com/events/direct/2026/
